items.criterion: A published open story is served in full to a caller holding no session, and its stored row carries the same title.
items.judgment: Read the story by its slug with no session and compare the served title with the stored row.

items.criterion: A draft story is refused on every address a stranger can construct: the index, the slug, the identifier and the cover route.
items.judgment: Request the draft story four ways and confirm each is refused.

items.criterion: A members story carries its intro and no body for a caller holding no session.
items.judgment: Read the members story signed out and inspect the payload for a body field.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous creates claiming one slug leave exactly one story row.
items.judgment: Run two creates together against one slug and count the rows.

items.criterion: Uploaded cover bytes exist as an object in the bucket at the pinned key scheme.
items.judgment: Upload a cover and confirm the object key the app answered with exists in the bucket.

items.criterion: A completed scan holds exactly four graded section rows against one overall grade.
items.judgment: Complete a scan and count its stored section rows.

items.criterion: One address scanned twice produces the same overall grade and the same four section grades.
items.judgment: Submit two scans of one address and compare the grades.

items.criterion: One newsletter address submitted twice holds exactly one subscriber row.
items.judgment: Submit one address twice and count the subscriber rows.

items.criterion: A reader session is refused at the author story list and at the story create endpoint.
items.judgment: Call both author endpoints with a reader session and confirm each is refused.

items.criterion: A signed-out request for the leads desk is refused.
items.judgment: Call the leads desk with no session and confirm the refusal.

items.criterion: The health route answers with a success status once the app is ready.
items.judgment: Call the health route and read the status.

items.criterion: A restart leaves three seeded accounts, five seeded stories and one seeded subscriber.
items.judgment: Count the seeded rows after the app has started.

items.criterion: The marketing routes read as one continuous near-black scene with one raised surface family.
items.judgment: Open each marketing route and compare the ground and the card treatment.

items.criterion: A scroll-bound reveal on the home route runs backwards when the reader scrolls back.
items.judgment: Scroll a revealed section down and then up and compare the frames.
